The exposure split, 50.5% vs 49.5% (planned 50.0% / 50.0%), matters most because it invalidates the result. The number the decision would eventually turn on is the primary lift, +0.81% (in percent change of Successful Search Rate). The split skew has no known cause, so the +0.81% lift may be an artifact. The document also says the mechanism is unknown, the scorecard has no segment cuts, and the lift may not come from the ranker. The pre-period and novelty checks were not run.
